text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout v2026.03.15 -> 5% traffic. Automated health checks detected a sawtooth pattern in request latencies and elevated 5xx across canary shards (canary-3, canary-7). Abort criteria met: error_rate > 2% for 3m. Initiating automated abort sequence and creating incident INC-4521. 

incident-bot: Paging on-call (olivia). Incident created: INC-4521. Severity: P1. Affected regions: us-west1, eu-central1.

olivia: I'm taking this. Thanks for the page. Can you paste the abort command the deploy system ran? Also any immediate customer-facing degradation? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Ran: `rwdctl rollout abort --id v2026.03.15 --scope canary` at 3109876551. Rollback started.

jamal: seeing the 5xx spike on the canary graph. quick snapshot: `5xx_rate: us-west1=2.4%, eu-central1=2.1%, us-east1=0.4%` over last 5m. Latency p95 jumping from 120ms -> 560ms in canaries intermittently (sawtooth).

anna: customer impact: error budget burn ~0.12% of daily SLO so far but there are ~12 user reports in Zendesk referencing generation failures. Nothing widespread yet but it's trending upslope.

olivia: good. Execute hard kill-switch for the canary traffic routing while rollback completes. I'll run the flag.

olivia: ```
# flip the canary routing flag
rwd-ops flags set routing.canary.v2026_03_15.enabled false --actor olivia
# verify
rwd-ops flags get routing.canary.v2026_03_15.enabled
```

deploy-bot: Flag flip acknowledged at 3109876570. Canary traffic routed back to baseline pool. Rollback continues.

marco: suspicious pattern: canary-3 shows a tight coupling to a new kernel selection that landed in this rollout (attention-optimizations:v2). Could be perf-regression for certain seq-len distributions. Suggest we freeze similar deployments until postmortem.

jamal: running quick canary dump: `curl -s http://canary-3.internal/health | jq .` -> returns intermittent 502/503 stack traces matching OOM-ish allocation in kv-cache layer. Pasting snippet:

```json
{"status":"degraded","errors":125,"top_error":"kv_cache_alloc_failed","recent_logs":"alloc failed: requested 1.2GB, available 0.8GB"}
```

anna: noted. Ops: are background jobs or batching configs changed in this rollout? We should confirm config diffs.

olivia: @marco can you grep the rollout diff? `git diff --name-only origin/main..release/v2026.03.15` — specifically looking for runtime config changes.

marco: confirmed differences: `runtime/kernel_selector.py` bumped to attention-optimizations:v2 and `inference/batching.yaml` has a lower `batch_target_tokens` for canary. Those combined could spike transient memory.

jamal: rollback status: 70% of canary traffic reverted, error rate trending down in eu/uw. Still watching canary-3.

incident-bot: Escalation note: Notifying runtime-ml and infra oncall.

olivia: opening short-lived mitigation: increase KV cache eviction aggressiveness on canaries to avoid alloc spikes while we roll back. Command: `infractl set kv_cache.eviction_threshold 0.6 --targets canary-*`

jamal: ran the command at 3109876598. canary-3 eviction threshold -> 0.6. Seeing immediate drop in allocation failures. 5xx down to 0.9% in canaries.

anna: I'll sync with support to post a brief customer message: "We've paused a rollout and are investigating intermittent request failures; fallback and normal service restored for most customers." Draft ready for review.

olivia: good. I'm going to hand off monitoring and triage to jamal in ~30m. I'll stay reachable. Next oncall is jamal. Tagging for formal handoff. :handshake:

jamal: taking handoff. I'll keep watches for 30m and follow up with a short incident summary. Any follow-ups: root cause hypothesis is kernel_selector change + batching config; kill-switch + eviction tweak mitigated.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete at 3109876612. Canary rollout v2026.03.15 fully aborted and traffic restored to baseline.

olivia: thanks all. Please keep notes in INC-4521 and add any diagnostics to the incident doc. I'll trigger a postmortem template once we have RCA details.

jamal: quick checklist I'm recording:
- rollback executed (deploy system)
- flag flip executed (routing.canary.* false)
- eviction tweak applied to canaries
- customer comms drafted and queued
- runtime-ml investigating kernel_selector changes

olivia: handing off to jamal. Handoff complete at 3109876620. Closing active coordination in thread; will update INC-4521 with timeline and links. :white_check_mark:
